topic.title: Drainage and Wastewater Management Plans / Sewer Capacity / Resilience
topic.source_contract: sewerage undertaker and catchment identity, statutory DWMP version, network and treatment capacity, current and future demand, asset health, flooding and spill risks, climate resilience, options, nature-based solutions, programme timing, funding, implementation, annual review and measured performance evidence

scope_guards: A company-level DWMP is not exact-site sewer capacity evidence.
Modelled capacity is not a connection offer.
A preferred intervention is not a delivered upgrade.
Planned development demand is not proof of available headroom.
A planning condition is not water-company acceptance.
Completed works are not measured treatment performance.
Annual review commitments are not verified risk reduction.
No score or promotion is written without exact catchment, capacity, acceptance, implementation and performance evidence.
